image_prompt.text: A chain of twelve stage platforms stacked one directly above the next up a tall narrow tower, linked by ramps, narrow bridges and small platforms, each stage roughly 15-20 studs above the one below and within jumpable spacing
Simple jump obstacles along each stage — small walls to hop over and gaps to jump across from one platform to the next
A large circular base platform at the foot of the tower where players gather and start the climb
A trophy platform crowning the very top of the tower as the payoff for clearing the last stage
Bright, vibrant multi-coloured platforms in the classic Roblox obby look — red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple and cyan, a different colour per stage

layout_placement.text: The end reward area at the summit, entered when a player clears the twelfth stage

notes: Preset Tower Obby kept with its shape course-tower; dropped its obstacle-timing and obstacle-climb because the prompt names its own obstacle set (small walls and gaps to jump across, connected by ramps and narrow bridges) rather than vanishing platforms or trusses and ladders. Added obstacle-jump and social-hub, which the preset lacks and the prompt asks for.

course-tower carries P6 + P2 because the prompt stacks the twelve stages directly above each other in a tall narrow tower; that is a genuine overhang, so the P2 override does not apply (and course-tower is not in the override table). The genre P6 is never overridden. P2 is not a shipped route yet, so this build is blocked on it.
No checkpoints emitted: the prompt does not mention them and Tower Obby does not include them.
Not buildable as map geometry, passed on for the pipeline: the request for configurable attributes covering number of stages, stage spacing, platform size, and colour scheme (bright vs pastel).
